description: List the signed-in owner's existing answering lines and setups awaiting payment. Use this first for line_id, status, number, billing_mode, balance, forwarding codes and the ten latest charged calls with masked caller numbers. Product packs and terms are in get_answering_line_offer; buy_line_pack tops up a line. get_line_calls and get_line_messages read its history, get_line_call_transcript reads one call, update_answering_line edits supported settings, and create_sip_address creates or retrieves SIP credentials. Paused lines report status paused and paused_at. pause_answering_line and resume_answering_line keep the prepaid balance and number. close_answering_line ends answering, keeps the unused balance recorded and reports closed_at; use the owner console for other settings and billing. Needs lines:manage; changes nothing; rate limited per account.
name: get_answering_line
title: The owner's answering lines: status, number, balance, recent calls
